ctx.x: So their whole, everything was about those things that they wanted to be. They were extremely circumspect, you know. It's, for instance, what saved John Kennedy. If he were alive and chasing women the way he did today, ah, damn, he'd be, you know.
Well, I often wonder how he had time to be president.
